concerns.text: FR-001 ends with '(See US-1)'. No identifier 'US-1' exists in the document; user stories are labeled 'User Story 1', 'User Story 2', etc. This broken cross‑reference prevents traceability.

FR-004 specifies a baseline 'TinyLSTM (quantized transformer)'. An LSTM is not a transformer, creating a contradictory description of the baseline model type and undermining the claim of comparing to a 'standard transformer architecture'.

The description of User Story 2 contains a garbled clause: 'ensuring the model runs entirely on CPU within the The study investigates the impact of constrained memory resources…'. This introduces a silent scope shift and makes the requirement unclear.
